206359: Wein is the crown prince of Natra. He will take over the future of the country on behalf of his sick father. Although the retainers trust him due do his superior position, he is actually lazy. He wants to sell the deadlocked kingdom of Natra and lead a comfortable retired life.
206373: An ambassador dispatched from the Earthworld Empire to the Kingdom of Natra. A calm and capable young bureaucrat who has earned the trust of Princess Lowellmina as her aide back in the Empire. She keeps a close eye on Wein's talent and movements.
206374: Ninym is a beautiful white-haired, red-eyed Flahm girl who is Wein's childhood friend. As his top aide, she assists him in everything from affairs of the state to combat. She is among the few who know what he is really like, as well as the kingdom's current dire straits.
206391: The younger sister of Wein Salema Arbalest.
206738: Originally a diplomat from the Kingdom of Marden. His patriotism and honest nature won Zenovia's trust, earning him a spot as her aide and right-hand man following the kingdom's transition to a vassal state.
206739: General of the Kingdom of Natra. A veteran of the battlefield, he is trusted by Wein with handling military affairs. He holds Wein's talents in high regard, and works to suppress the local lords who are dissatisfied with his leadership.
206740: Commander of the Kingdom of Natra's army. He is loyal to Wein, spearheading him into battle, and in some cases serving as his bodyguard. Though he has a large physique, his modest nature keeps him from seeming intimidating.
206741: The youngest princess of the Earthworld Empire and a former classmate of Wein and Ninym.
206742: He oversees the Jilaat Gold Mine.
206743: Wein's friend from his time abroad in the Empire.
206744: Wein's friend from his time abroad in the Empire.
206745: General of Marden's army. Falls in battle against Ninym.
206747: Finance Minister for the Kingdom of Marden.
206748: The ambassador succeeding Fyshe after she got dismissed from her post.
206750: Nanaki is the bodyguard of princess Falanya Elk Arbalest.
207180: Director of Levetia's Gospel Bureau. She is a shrewd woman who rose to the position of director of the prestigious Gospel Bureau, in a society where women are not allowed to hold important positions.
207181: An executive officer in the Marden Liberation Army. He is the aide of Prince Helmut, the leader of the army. A brilliant man with keen insight, but there are times when he becomes emotionally absorbed in his vengeance against the Kingdom of Cavarin, which conquered his homeland.

207648: The second prince of the Earthworld Empire. Trained as a warrior from an early age and well versed in military affairs; he is supported by the Imperial military.
263708: Falanya's instructor, as well as Wein's during his childhood.
